Can leaving a successful IT career and becoming a farmer actually be profitable? 🌱💰

In this AgroTill Exclusive, we bring you the inspiring story of Rakesh, an IT professional who decided to leave the corporate world and build his journey in agriculture.

Today, his focus is on commercial cut flower farming, particularly hybrid chrysanthemum cultivation 🌺 — a flower crop with strong demand in the market and opportunities for farmers looking to build a profitable floriculture business.

In this video, we take you inside Growteq Agri Farms to understand how modern flower farming works, from cultivation to harvesting and marketing.

🌺 What you will learn in this video:

🌱 Rakesh’s journey from IT professional to farmer
🌺 Why he chose hybrid chrysanthemum farming
🏡 How cut flowers are cultivated commercially
💰 Investment required for flower farming
📈 Production, income & profit potential
🌱 Crop management and cultivation practices
🌸 Harvesting of chrysanthemum flowers
